question: What manufacturer warranty periods are listed in Table 2A-5 for each retroreflective sheeting type?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The evidence does not support the premise of the question. Table 2A-5 does not list manufacturer warranty periods at all — it specifies "Minimum Maintained Retroreflectivity Levels" (in cd/lx/m², measured at an observation angle of 0.2° and an entrance angle of -4.0°) by sign color for Beaded Sheeting Types I, II, and III (ASTM D4956) and for Prismatic Sheeting. No warranty information for any sheeting type appears in the table or the surrounding provisions, so I cannot answer the question as posed. Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2A-5, which contains minimum retroreflectivity thresholds (e.g., White on Green post-mounted: W*; G ≥ 7 for Type I beaded sheeting; W ≥ 120; G ≥ 15 for prismatic sheeting) organized by sign color and sheeting type, with no column or note addressing manufacturer warranty periods. Citations: - Table 2A-5 (p.62) - Section 2A.22 Standard §2 (p.62)
